title: Data Analyst
snippet: Work with SQL, dashboards, and business stakeholders to turn data into decisions.
description: Own analytics projects end-to-end, build dashboards, and support business teams with insights.

title: Junior Business Intelligence Specialist
snippet: Support BI reporting, maintain ETL pipelines, and help deliver insights to business units.
description: Entry-level BI role focused on reporting, maintaining data pipelines, and assisting senior analysts.

title: Product Data Associate
snippet: Bridge product and data: track KPIs, run experiments, and help prioritize features.
description: Work closely with product managers to track metrics, analyze data, and support product decisions.

title: Marketing Data Analyst
snippet: Analyze campaign performance and build dashboards for the marketing team.
description: Help optimize digital campaigns through data insights and reporting automation.

title: Operations Analyst
snippet: Improve operational workflows and analyze process performance.
description: Support operations teams by analyzing KPIs, optimizing workflows, and suggesting improvements.
